event_name: India imposes 100% tariff on imports from Vietnam
source: Indian Ministry of Commerce and Industry
description: The Indian government has imposed a 100% tariff on goods imported from Vietnam, covering key agri-commodities including cashew, black pepper and green coffee. Buyers at Mumbai and Chennai gateways face immediate cost escalation and renegotiation of supply contracts; spot shortages are expected over the next 30 days.
